classes.name: Intf
classes.summary: Interference computation between polygons, lines and polyhedra with only triangular facets. These objects are polygonal representations of complex curves and triangulated representations of complex surfaces.

staticMethods.name: PlaneEquation
staticMethods.signature: (P1: gp_Pnt, P2: gp_Pnt, P3: gp_Pnt, NormalVector: gp_XYZ, PolarDistance: number): { PolarDistance: number }

staticMethods.name: Contain
staticMethods.signature: (P1: gp_Pnt, P2: gp_Pnt, P3: gp_Pnt, ThePnt: gp_Pnt): boolean

classes.name: Intf_Interference
classes.summary: Describes the Interference computation result between polygon2d or polygon3d or polyhedron (as three sequences of points of intersection, polylines of intersection and zones de tangence).

instanceMethods.name: NbSectionLines
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the number of polylines of intersection in the interference.

instanceMethods.name: LineValue
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the polyline of intersection at address <Index> in the interference.

instanceMethods.name: NbTangentZones
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the number of zones of tangence in the interference.

instanceMethods.name: ZoneValue
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the zone of tangence at address Index in the interference.

instanceMethods.name: GetTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the tolerance used for the calculation.

instanceMethods.name: Insert
instanceMethods.comment: Inserts a new zone of tangence in the current list of tangent zones of the interference and returns True when done.

classes.name: Intf_InterferencePolygon2d
classes.summary: Computes the interference between two polygons or the self intersection of a polygon in two dimensions.

constructors.name: constructor

constructors.name: constructor

instanceMethods.name: Perform

instanceMethods.name: Pnt2dValue
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the geometrical 2d point of the intersection point at address <Index> in the interference.

classes.name: Intf_Polygon2d
classes.summary: Describes the necessary polygon information to compute the interferences.

instanceMethods.name: Bounding

instanceMethods.name: Closed

instanceMethods.name: DeflectionOverEstimation

instanceMethods.name: NbSegments

classes.name: Intf_SectionLine
classes.summary: Describe a polyline of intersection between two polyhedra as a sequence of points of intersection.

instanceMethods.name: IsClosed
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the SectionLine is closed.

instanceMethods.name: IsEqual
instanceMethods.comment: Compares two SectionLines.

instanceMethods.name: Append
instanceMethods.comment:
Adds a point at the end of the SectionLine.
@param LS Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: Prepend
instanceMethods.comment:
Adds a point to the beginning of the SectionLine <me>.
@param LS Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: Reverse
instanceMethods.comment: Reverses the order of the elements of the SectionLine.

instanceMethods.name: Close
instanceMethods.comment: Closes the SectionLine.

instanceMethods.comment:
Gives the parameter range of the TangentZone on the first argument of the Interference. (Usable only for polygon).
@returns A result object with fields:

- `paraMax`: updated value from the call.
